ReviewScorePreference_Desc: On products where you see this symbol next to the Review Score, we're excluding reviews that are not relevant to you. These reasons for excluding reviews can be either or both of the following:

ReviewScorePreference_Include: Include reviews from all Steam purchases
ReviewScorePreference_Point1: Off-topic review activity, where we believe the content of the reviews is largely unrelated to the likelihood that you would enjoy the product.
ReviewScorePreference_Point2: Reviews written in another language, if there are a sufficient number of reviews written in your language.
